title: Introduction: mirrors and blind spots
learningObjective: Learn what each view control shows before the moving-off exercise. Not assessed.
briefing:
Optional guided introduction (not assessed)

You stay parked. Road users pass so you can see where each view looks. Tap a view to look there; tap it again, or tap Forward, to look ahead. You can also swipe to look around.

Interior mirror: straight behind. Right mirror and Left mirror: behind on each side. Right shoulder and Left shoulder: the blind spots beside and behind you that the mirrors do not show.

actions.text: Tap Interior mirror: it shows the road straight behind you.
The purple car is coming from behind on your right. Tap Right mirror to find it.
Now tap Right shoulder: as it comes alongside, the mirror no longer shows it.
The yellow cyclist is coming from behind on your left, near the kerb. Tap Left mirror.
Watch the cyclist move out to pass you on the right. Tap Right shoulder, then Forward.
They repeat. Practise each view; the introduction finishes on its own.
